entities.name: Viral replication-associated protein
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt A0A1P8YT89 from Avon-Heathcote Estuary associated kieseladnavirus.
Length 474 aa; calculated molecular mass 53.33 kDa; theoretical pI 6.11; predicted net charge at pH 7 is -7.0.
Contains a Pfam RNA_helicase domain (PF00910.29) at residues 268–331.
Contains the sequence motif VILYGAAGTGKTT, consistent with a P-loop NTPase/helicase motor region.

Curated homolog annotations describe essential viral DNA replication activity, RNA binding, RNA helicase activity, and presumed cleavage of viral genomic dsRNA replicative form to initiate rolling-circle replication.
Reported localization for homologs is the host cell nucleus.
